name: Pirenperone
summary: Pirenperone is a serotonin receptor antagonist closely related to ketanserin and risperidone which is described as an antipsychotic and tranquilizer and was never marketed.

pharmacology.text: Pirenperone (INN, USAN, BAN; developmental code names R-47456 and R-50656) is a serotonin receptor antagonist closely related to ketanserin and risperidone which is described as an antipsychotic and tranquilizer and was never marketed. It is a relatively selective antagonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor and has been used in scientific research to study the serotonin system.

fact.en: Its R code names mark it as a compound from Janssen Pharmaceutica, the Belgian company that also produced haloperidol and risperidone.
